cc1101_antenna.retention: use a purchased matching bulkhead or split grommet; stock antenna exits here unmodified

engineering_notes: All purchased-part heights and cable routing remain provisional until measured.
ZAC93 has a stock on-board antenna, not an added SMA connector. Preserve it unmodified.
LD2450 antenna face points toward +Z through the lid; mount the unit with that face toward the room.
Cradles use insulated edge support and soft nylon straps, never invented holes through a module.
The PoE splitter must be an isolated 802.3af/at PD; battery voltage never enters this enclosure directly.
Ambient pod is screwed to two stand-off arms; no loose external sensor box.
PWR1 replaces the Pololu tray with a 24 x 24 mm insulated perfboard assembly for RECOM R-78K3.3-1.0 and its 27 uF input capacitor; no mounting holes are assumed in either component.

MC2-D replaces TinyC6[D] with pre-soldered XIAO ESP32C6. Its factory header plastic gives a nominal 2.54 mm gap above the carrier; EN/BOOT underside fine-wire joints use the native carrier access window. No female sockets are added.

U1 and U3 use explicit 2.54 mm nominal factory-header gaps, not the former generic 9 mm module plane. The 32 mm coax approach plane keeps the 150 mm harness budget valid; all socket heights remain fit-check allocations.
